{
  "phoneNote": "The oversized opening-hours badge pushes the bread photograph almost entirely below the first screen, weakening an otherwise warm, bakery-specific design.",
  "desktopNote": "The strong photographic hero is undermined further down by two consecutive sourdough-story sections using the same kneading photograph.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,

    "spacing": 3,

  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "On phones, replace the standalone opening-hours circle with a compact label over the bread photograph and tighten the hero spacing so a substantial portion of the bread is visible above the fixed bar.",
    "Merge the two sourdough-story sections into one focused section with a single kneading photograph, removing the repeated heading, explanation and attribution.",
    "Rebalance the desktop yellow promotion: give its headline a wider column so it does not break into four short lines, and group the supporting text and order link beneath it."
  ]
}
